description: What recipes have people and Gusto shared on What's Cooking? Inputs (all optional): query (matched against titles, tags and ingredients), author (e.g. "Gusto"), limit (default 5, max 20). Returns short picks; call get_explore_recipe with an id for the full recipe. Example: {"query":"chicken","author":"Gusto"}

author.description: Only recipes by this author, e.g. "Gusto".

query.description: A dish, ingredient or tag, e.g. "chicken" or "vegan".

name: browse_explore
title: Browse recipes on Explore
